title: Building an Entrepreneurial Mindset
author: E-Cell LIET
excerpt: Entrepreneurship starts with curiosity, problem-solving and the willingness to learn from every attempt.
content: An entrepreneurial mindset is less about having a perfect idea and more about learning to identify problems, test assumptions and create value.
At E-Cell LIET, students can develop these habits through workshops, competitions, mentoring and practical projects.

title: From a Campus Problem to a Startup Idea
author: E-Cell LIET
excerpt: A simple framework for turning an everyday campus problem into a problem worth solving.
content: Good startup ideas often begin with problems that people repeatedly experience.
Start by observing the problem, speaking with potential users, defining the smallest useful solution and testing it before investing heavily in development.

title: Why Student Communities Matter
author: E-Cell LIET
excerpt: The right peer community can turn isolated ideas into collaborative experiments and real initiatives.
content: Student communities create an environment for peer learning, collaboration and experimentation.
An active E-Cell can connect students with mentors, founders, industry professionals and other students who are willing to build.

title: Learning Through Entrepreneurship Competitions
author: E-Cell LIET
excerpt: Competitions can make entrepreneurship practical by turning ideas into time-bound challenges.
content: Entrepreneurship competitions provide a structured environment to research, build, present and receive feedback.
The experience can help students strengthen communication, teamwork, problem-solving and execution skills.
